facts.offer: USD $200 Public Cloud credit; no code required
facts.conditions: First Public Cloud project; no previous Public Cloud purchase. US datacenter services only; purchase at least $0.99. Subject to availability. Credit is not cash or a VPS price.
facts.label: US Public Cloud trial terms

facts.conditions: First Managed Databases purchase for Public Cloud under the same eligibility terms; up to $300 total. Credits applied within 30 days of qualifying payment and valid for 90 days after application. Unused credits expire; continuing use is billed after exhaustion or expiry.
facts.label: US Public Cloud trial terms

facts.offer: Savings Plan: 15% for 12 months; 30% for 36 months
facts.conditions: Eligible B3, C3 and R3 instances and Managed Kubernetes nodes. Local Zones and Windows licenses excluded. Usage beyond the commitment is billed at regular hourly rates.
facts.label: US Savings Plan pricing

facts.conditions: Auto-renewal is disabled by default. If enabled, renewal uses the same duration and the advertised price at renewal. This is commitment pricing, not a coupon.
facts.label: US Savings Plan FAQ

facts.conditions: Fees are non-cancelable and non-refundable except where the agreement or applicable law provides otherwise. Credits and cancellation are not a money-back guarantee.
facts.label: US Terms of Service

faq.question: Is an OVHcloud promo code listed here?
faq.answer: No public code was verified. The US Public Cloud credit terms explicitly say no code is required. Follow the official trial page to review eligibility before creating a project.

faq.question: Can I use these credits for a VPS subscription?
faq.answer: The verified offer covers Public Cloud services. We have not verified eligibility for a separate VPS subscription.

faq.question: Is a Savings Plan a one-time coupon?
faq.answer: No. It is a resource commitment. Excess usage is charged separately, and unused committed capacity does not remove the commitment charge.
